question: How many customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: List the suppliers based in Canada.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country='Canada'

question: How many sales orders are still open?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE status='Open'

question: What is the list price of the Feed wagon FW-300?
gold_sql: SELECT list_price FROM parts WHERE description='Feed wagon FW-300'

question: Which supplier has the longest lead time?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many work orders are on hold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders WHERE status='On hold'

question: How many units of part PI-1007 do we have on hand across all warehouses?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.qty_on_hand) FROM inventory i JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=i.part_id WHERE p.part_number='PI-1007'

question: Which parts are below their reorder point, counting available stock (on hand minus allocated) across all warehouses?
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number FROM parts p JOIN inventory i ON i.part_id=p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_id HAVING SUM(i.qty_on_hand-i.qty_allocated) < p.reorder_point

question: How many customers do we have in each province?
gold_sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY province

question: What is the total value of all purchase orders placed with Midwest Hydraulics (quantity ordered times unit price)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.qty_ordered*l.unit_price),2) FROM po_lines l JOIN purchase_orders o ON o.po_id=l.po_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id=o.supplier_id WHERE s.name='Midwest Hydraulics'

question: Which purchase orders are partially received? Give their numbers.
gold_sql: SELECT po_id FROM purchase_orders WHERE status='Partially received'

question: How many units of each finished good have we sold on shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.description, SUM(l.qty) FROM so_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.so_id=l.so_id JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=l.part_id WHERE o.status='Shipped' GROUP BY p.description

question: Which work orders are due in October 2026 and not complete?
gold_sql: SELECT wo_id FROM work_orders WHERE due_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND status<>'Complete'

question: What is the average lead time of our suppliers, by country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(AVG(lead_time_days),1) FROM suppliers GROUP BY country

question: What was our total sales revenue from shipped orders, in CAD?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price),2) FROM so_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.so_id=l.so_id WHERE o.status='Shipped'

question: Who are our top 3 customers by revenue on shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN sales_orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN so_lines l ON l.so_id=o.so_id WHERE o.status='Shipped' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

question: For parts below their reorder point (available stock across warehouses), who is the supplier? Skip parts we make ourselves.
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, s.name FROM parts p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id JOIN inventory i ON i.part_id=p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_id HAVING SUM(i.qty_on_hand-i.qty_allocated) < p.reorder_point

question: How many units are still to be received on open or partially received purchase orders, per part number?
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, SUM(l.qty_ordered-l.qty_received) FROM po_lines l JOIN purchase_orders o ON o.po_id=l.po_id JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=l.part_id WHERE o.status IN ('Open','Partially received') GROUP BY p.part_number

question: Which province brought in the most revenue from shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.province FROM customers c JOIN sales_orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN so_lines l ON l.so_id=o.so_id WHERE o.status='Shipped' GROUP BY c.province ORDER BY SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the gross margin per unit (list price minus unit cost) for each finished good?
gold_sql: SELECT description, list_price-unit_cost FROM parts WHERE category='Finished good'

question: On average, how many days did shipped orders take from order date to ship date?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(ship_date)-julianday(order_date)),1) FROM sales_orders WHERE status='Shipped'

question: On orders that were not cancelled, do dealers or direct farms pay a lower average unit price for the Bale processor BP-500?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(l.unit_price),2) FROM so_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.so_id=l.so_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN parts p ON p.part_id=l.part_id WHERE p.description='Bale processor BP-500' AND o.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment
